prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [choose_path, redesign] Path Explorer Spotlight Layout Redesign: Redesign the choose_path screen into a spotlight layout that highlights each journey path and companion preview in detail.
   config: {"choose_path": {"layout": "spotlight", "show_step_counter": true}}
1: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Options Grid Layout: Rebuild the sign-in screen into a structured grid layout displaying all available login options with account continuity context.
   config: {"sign_in": {"layout": "grid", "show_progress": true}}
2: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Spotlight Selection Redesign: Redesign the pick_friend screen using a spotlight layout to showcase pet personality traits and full visual previews prominently.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "spotlight"}}
3: [home, new_screen] Desktop Dock Verification Screen: Add a dedicated desktop dock verification screen during the home stage to ensure the desktop background and app tray are ready for launch.
   config: {"_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "new_dock_verify", "home_intro"], "new_dock_verify": {"headline": "Checking Desktop Compatibility", "body": "Verifying screen overlay permissions and system tray access for your companion.", "layout": "checklist", "button_label": "Continue to Desktop"}}
4: [finish, redesign] Home Intro Split Stage Overview: Redesign the home_intro finish screen into a split stage layout separating companion welcome from tray control instructions.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "split", "show_step_counter": true}}
5: [adoption, hint] Custom Pet Photo Lighting Guidance Hint: Add an explicit photo upload hint explaining optimal lighting and single-subject framing for custom pets.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Ensure bright, even lighting and a clear front-facing view for accurate custom pet creation."}}
6: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Background Ready Notification: Configure the waiting screen with ready notifications enabled and status indicator updates during companion asset generation.
   config: {"waiting": {"notify_when_ready": true, "show_progress": true, "headline": "Generating Companion Assets..."}}
7: [sign_in, hint] Sign In Account Continuity Reminder Hint: Display a hint on the sign-in screen advising users to log in with their primary email to avoid duplicate account creation.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Use your existing account email to automatically recover and sync your pets."}}
8: [choose_path, layout] Story Card View Layout Redesign: Update the story screen to use a clean card layout with step counter visibility.
   config: {"story": {"layout": "card", "show_step_counter": true}}
9: [finish, hint] Home Intro System Tray Controls Hint: Add a hint on the final screen explaining how to summon, minimize, or chat with the pet via the desktop system tray icon.
   config: {"home_intro": {"hint": "Click the desktop tray icon or right-click your pet to toggle visibility, settings, and companion chat."}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigning choose_path into a spotlight layout maintains all required screen functions within onboarding.
Grid layout redesign for sign-in retains account login functionality and onboarding flow integrity.
Spotlight layout redesign for pick_friend preserves pet selection functionality without violating onboarding rules.
Adding a compatibility verification screen during onboarding is permitted under Rule 4 and maintains all required steps.
Split stage layout redesign for home_intro retains welcome and control instructions within onboarding limits.
Adding photo upload guidance text assists custom pet creation without violating pricing or fair design rules.
Configuring notifications and status indicators on the waiting screen enhances status visibility without adding false urgency.
Adding an account continuity hint on the sign-in screen provides helpful sign-in context without requesting unnecessary new personal data.
Updating story layout to a card view with step progress maintains screen functionality and retains onboarding flow.
Adding a desktop tray control hint on home_intro informs users of pet controls within allowed onboarding modifications.
